Correctional Officer Darick Kerns recognized as outstanding employee for third quarter
Correctional Officer Darick Kerns has been named Outstanding Employee at Garrett County Detention Center for Q3 2026. The recognition highlights his dedication after less than a year with the Sheriff’s Office. The department continues its focus on community safety.
Sheriff Meyers and the staff of the Garrett County Sheriff’s Office congratulated Correctional Officer Darick Kerns on Oct. 7 for being recognized as the Garrett County Detention Center’s Outstanding Employee for the Third Quarter of 2026.
Kerns has served with the Sheriff’s Office for just under one year and is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of individuals in custody at the detention center. The office said, “Darick consistently demonstrates outstanding work ethic and dedication, often volunteering for overtime and going above and beyond what is expected.”
The announcement highlighted that Kerns maintains a positive attitude in all situations, setting an example through professionalism and leadership. The statement continued, “Always eager to learn, he actively seeks opportunities to grow and advance within the ranks, making him an invaluable asset to the department.”
Kerns was commended by his colleagues for his hard work, dedication, and commitment to the agency. The Garrett County Sheriff's Office serves as a law enforcement agency dedicated to community security and crime prevention across areas including Oakland and Garrett Highway in Maryland; it provides services such as arrests, traffic stops, K-9 unit deployments, incident investigations, and addresses offenses like trespassing or drug possession while encouraging public involvement in crime prevention through tips or rewards leading to arrests, according to the official website.
The recognition reflects ongoing efforts by local law enforcement agencies to promote professionalism among staff members while enhancing public safety throughout Garrett County.
